mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike, or the UNRATE spike explains < 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and compress S&P 500 margins, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 3-month periods following a 2% INDPRO drop, or the INDPRO drop explains < 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and pressures S&P 500 earnings, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of 3-month periods following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS hike, or the FEDFUNDS hike explains < 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure S&P 500 earnings and drive negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 5% HOUST drop, or the HOUST drop explains < 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage pressures and compress S&P 500 margins, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of 2-month periods following a 300k PAYEMS spike, or the PAYEMS spike explains < 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in CPI inflation signals a loss of purchasing power that will erode consumer spending and pressure S&P 500 earnings, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5% CPI spike, or the CPI spike explains < 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure S&P 500 earnings and drive negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of 2-month periods following a 2% RSAFS drop, or the RSAFS drop explains < 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a walk-forward regression.
